source: Official Unruled Games announcements on Steam (ISteamNews)

entries.title: Update 1.0.8 — Smoother Mining & Co-op Fixes
highlights: Less stuttering while mining, flying and aboard the ship; lower video memory use.
The jetpack now recharges in mid-air.
The Compactor now also applies to the ship's hold, and one more cargo upgrade is available.
No Rush mode gets a No blackouts option.
Teammate markers are always visible in co-op; darts can be played together.
Fixes for co-op black screens, premature victory, unreachable final fragments and first-aid kits being used too early.

entries.title: Update 1.0.7 — Co-op & Performance Improvements
highlights: Lance and Slicer respond better for co-op guests.
Shorter co-op delays and better session recovery after updating.
Better frame pacing; default frame limit raised to 120 FPS.
Rebindable roll controls while airborne.
Daily orders no longer ask for minerals you can't get.

entries.title: Update 1.0.6 — Improvements & Co-op Fixes
highlights: Mining contribution statistics in Engineering.
Two more cargo upgrades; ship modules can now be sold.
New Game+ is available more widely, with bigger rewards in later years.
Days no longer advance automatically in No Rush or after an ending.
Fixes for severe co-op slowdowns and guest achievements.

entries.title: New Game+ Bonuses, Mining & Co-op Improvements
highlights: New Game+: pick two of three permanent bonuses when starting the next year.
The Slicer cuts three times as often; the Lance no longer pushes you backward.
Selling the Lance or Slicer no longer re-locks it in the Workshop.
Fixed unreachable repair spots; cleaning now works on the lowest graphics setting.
Completed asteroid shapes are marked on the sector map.

entries.title: Gear, Progression & Co-op Improvements
highlights: Hand tools can be sold back at the Workshop; save slots can be copied.
Upgraded boots can anchor you to the asteroid; late jetpack upgrades fly much longer.
Mineral prices recover faster overnight and big sales lose less.
Strange Matter: a new asteroid heart in new campaigns and new years.
Ore collected by ship guns now counts toward daily delivery objectives.

entries.title: Balance & Progression — Fixes and Improvements
highlights: Ship weapons strengthened and upgrade progression improved.
Core mining restrictions and Neutronium market prices adjusted.
Ship weapon objectives added to daily objectives.
The Spring Cleaning achievement is easier to unlock.

entries.title: Update 1.0.2 — Rock Sales, a Stronger Lance & Fixes
highlights: From day 35, ordinary rock fills spare cargo and sells for $2 per unit.
Stronger Lance: more mining power, faster charge; right-click switches charged and continuous fire.
The Lance and Slicer now unlock after buying an Orbital Strike or Collapsar.
Scanner: pick a colour per mineral or hide minerals you don't want.
Ship cleaning pays $5 per restored spot and $100 per finished room, once per campaign.

entries.title: Co-op Chat & Fixes
highlights: Co-op text chat on T (rebindable).
Resolution selector and an option to hide the ore health bar.
Empty landers return sooner; daily orders account for what's left in the asteroid.

entries.title: No Asteroids is out now!
highlights: Full release on Windows and macOS, solo or with up to seven friends.
20% launch discount until December 8.

entries.title: Personal Co-op Gear, Shaker Charges & Fixes
highlights: Hosts choose shared or personal co-op gear; crew money stays shared. With personal gear, the Laser, Plasma Cutter and Missile Swarm cost the solo price.
Five save slots.
Shaker charges reworked to shake ore loose and pull it toward you.

entries.title: Stronger Drones, Tunnel Mode & Co-op Fixes
highlights: Missile Swarm Tunnel Mode: right-click to switch between spread fire and a focused, deeper salvo.
Carry 12 standard charges by default, up to 24 with upgrades.
Hard mode: about 25% less ore, 90% ore income and 50% pricier ship guns.
Co-op: ore pays 90% after multiplayer shifts; Laser, Plasma Cutter and Missile Swarm cost +50% for two players and +100% for three or more.

entries.title: Save Slots, Hard Mode & Co-op Improvements
highlights: New difficulty: The hard way. By the contract is the recommended mode.
Show teammates' names and outlines through rock (middle mouse by default).
Antimatter base price raised from $56 to $150.

entries.title: The No Asteroids demo is out now
highlights: Free demo on Steam covering the start of the contract.
